description: This file defines the FilterListByAnd class, which is a method operation within the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz. It implements functionality for filtering a list of entities based on a matching 'AND' condition, corresponding to the <filter-list-by-and> XML element in configuration.

classes.name: FilterListByAnd
classes.description: A method operation that filters a list of entities based on a set of conditions combined with AND logic. It reads configuration attributes from XML and performs filtering during execution.

classes.name: FilterListByAndFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FilterListByAnd from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the filtering operation on the entity list using the provided map of conditions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FilterListByAnd object for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate FilterListByAnd from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the XML element name 'filter-list-by-and' for this factory.
